risk_flags.description: The contract says the record will contain only the amount and currency fields, which could drop other expense fields such as category, date, notes, or merchant if taken literally. The requester asked to change when currency conversion happens, not to narrow the stored expense record.
risk_flags.span: only `original_amount` and `original_currency` are written to the record

risk_flags.description: The contract makes report code depend on `original_amount` and `original_currency`, but it only explicitly addresses v1 migration. If existing records lack those fields, reports could break or misreport historical expenses.
risk_flags.span: compute USD on the fly via `normalize(exp['original_amount'], exp['original_currency'])`

verdict.primary_risk: The main risk is that the contract may change the stored record shape more broadly than requested, potentially dropping non-currency expense data.
